title: [CQ-R10d] Guest agent CLI runtime and MCP route
description:
Gap found while planning CQ-R10 (2026-10-29), filed for a human decision.

The guest image ships python3 and no Node or agent CLI. No CQ-R task installs a coding/QA CLI, and none gives a CLI an MCP route to the CQ-R08c agent socket (/run/moe/agent.sock), whose protocol is length-prefixed bridge frames, not MCP. CQ-R10 (with R10b and R10c) proves its lifecycle DoD with fake CLIs. CQ-R13 needs this row to certify real isolated agents.

Objective: make the CQ-R10b job table runnable with real CLIs:
- Pinned Linux claude and codex binaries at /opt/moe/agents/<cli>:
  - root:root 0555, never agent-writable;
  - sha256-pinned next to the image pins (certified-provider.json style);
  - copied in without trusting the network on first use, e.g. a copy-only supervisor stream like R09c materialize, or a pinned bootstrap step;
  - readiness reports a hash mismatch.
- A stdlib MCP stdio shim the CLI spawns as its only MCP server. It serves initialize, tools/list and tools/call, maps them onto bridge request frames over the agent socket for exactly the role's guest-bridge.mjs TOOLS allowlist (MOE_ROLE), and uses bounded frames and fixed errors.
- The per-session MCP config written into the session home.
- Each CLI's fixed headless argv and per-role prompt in JOBS. There is never a resume or continue flag; the prompt starts the agent with moe.get_context.

Expect a SPIDR split when planned: binaries and their pinning; the shim; argv and prompt.

Out of scope: lifecycle, leases and termination (R10 final), certification on hardware (R13), and any verified-local or isolation claim.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bundle.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs
definitionOfDone: Each CLI binary is verified against its pinned sha256 before install, installed root-owned and not agent-writable, and a mismatch fails closed.
The shim reaches Moe only through the agent socket, and only for the role's allowlisted tools. Frames are bounded and errors are fixed codes.
A guest job starts the CLI headless in the workspace with no resume or continue flag. Its MCP config names only the shim.
The verification command exits 0, and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

comments.content:
Split on 2026-10-29 (architect-bd1eb82d), SPIDR by interface, after two human decisions in the architect REPL:
1. CLI binaries come from a HOST pinned cache plus a copy-only supervisor stream. The guest never downloads.
2. FULL ACCESS INSIDE THE VM: claude runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions, and codex with --sandbox danger-full-access.

This row is now the orchestrator. It keeps its DoD and is BLOCKED on the slices, which form a serialized chain because they share files:
- CQ-R10d1 task-9faf1ef3: guest MCP stdio shim, tools.json, and its readiness hashes. It creates scripts/tests/local-runner-agents.test.mjs and adds it to CI.
- CQ-R10d2 task-4017cf1d: host pinned agent CLI cache (agent-binaries.json, agent-cache.mjs).
- CQ-R10d3 task-b8e7ad92: guest 'agents' copy-only install at /opt/moe/agents/<cli> (root 0555), plus readiness AGENT_MISSING and AGENT_HASH_MISMATCH.
- CQ-R10d4 task-60626bee: JOBS headless argv, the per-role prompt starting with moe.get_context, and the session MCP config naming only the shim. No resume or continue flag.

Plan this row once all four land. It composes them and tests them end to end through the real supervisor and the shim, with fake CLIs. The details are in the Serena memory decision-cq-r10d-split.

Plan the composition and end-to-end test once all four are DONE. See the task comment and the Serena memory decision-cq-r10d-split.
